data.title: Vivy · 缝纫与服装保养
data.description: 休息室，她自己缝补演出服的披风边缘，针脚精准得像机器——本来就是机器；但哼着歌缝衣服的样子，比任何人类都更像「生活」。
data.action: 休息室，她自己缝补演出服的披风边缘，针脚精准得像机器——本来就是机器
data.promptProse: Seated on a vintage stool beside an antique sewing machine in her private green room, Vivy carefully mends an embroidered hem on her stage cape spread across her knees. A warm gooseneck work lamp illuminates thread spools, tailoring shears, and her calm, composed expression.
data.animaCaption: She mends the performance cape across her lap under the warm work lamp.
